service_account_key_ref.description: 1Password reference to the service-account JSON (op://<vault>/<item>/<field>). NEVER a raw secret per ADMINISTRATEME_BUILD.md §L1.

oauth_credentials_ref.description: macOS Keychain reference to installed-user OAuth credentials.

tasklist_id.description: Google Tasks tasklist id (e.g. '@default') the adapter polls and writes to. Maps to ListItemAddedV1.list_external_id.

provider_account_id.description: Stable non-secret account identifier stored in reminder provenance; defaults to user_email.

workspace.description: Exact reviewed isolation workspace for this account.

read_only.description: When true, request only tasks.readonly and expose no provider write capabilities.

include_all_tasklists.description: Discover and mirror all task lists instead of only tasklist_id.

show_assigned.description: Include assigned tasks and preserve their read-only assignment provenance.

assigned_tasks_read_only.description: Conservatively disable writes for tasks whose assignmentInfo carries provider restrictions.

user_email.description: The Google Workspace user the service account impersonates (domain-wide delegation subject).

member_id.description: AdministrateMe member id that owns this Google Tasks integration; passed through to ListItemAddedV1.member_id.

service_principal_id.description: Exact non-human owner for a reviewed CoS Google Tasks source.

list_name.description: Optional display name for the tasklist; defaults to tasklist_id when absent. Surfaced via ListItemAddedV1.list_name.

poll_interval_s.description: In-process inbound-poll cadence in seconds. Defaults to 60s; pack.yaml's cron is a heartbeat the supervisor uses to detect a wedged adapter.

sensitivity_floor.description: Adapter sensitivity floor. Config may RAISE the floor but cannot LOWER it below the hardcoded class default per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10.
